pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: The Warped Mushlin King uses a separate shooting state. A spit sound and appearance change accompany the projectile launch: move across the line, then retaliate

pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: in the pause. Shooting completion and movement recovery are tracked separately, so avoid waiting directly in front of it.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. Start combat from the boss encounter menu. In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.
